ma.nextTick(function callback)

Defer some operations to the next time slice (similar to setTimeout).

Parameter

function callback

Description

The setData and triggerEvent APIs in the custom components are synchronous operations. When these APIs are called consecutively, they are executed in a synchronization process. Therefore, errors may occur if the logic is improper.

An extreme case is as follows: When setData of the parent component triggers triggerEvent of the child component, the parent component performs setData again. During this period, the ma:If statement uninstalls the child component, which may cause a strange error. Therefore, for logic that does not need to be completed in a synchronization process, you can defer this interface execution to the next time slice.

Sample Code

Component({
  doSth() {
    this.setData({ number: 1}) // Directly executed in the current synchronization process.

    ma.nextTick(() => {
      this.setData({ number: 3}) // Executed in the next time slice after the current synchronization process ends.
    })

    this.setData({ number: 2}) // Directly executed in the current synchronization process.
  }
})
